note: Complete 48-sign compendium matching exact Kenyan Traffic Sign Charts (Command & Directional, Pictionary Warnings, and Prohibitory/Load Limits).

signs.label: Stop (Statutory Regulation R1)
signs.meaning: Come to a complete, absolute stop at the white stop line. Check all directions for approaching traffic and pedestrians before moving again.

signs.label: Stop / Go Control (Manual Checkpoint)
signs.meaning: Manual traffic control sign or flag used at road works and police checkpoints. Obey the sign face shown toward your approach lane.

signs.label: Give Way / Yield (Statutory Regulation R2)
signs.meaning: Slow down immediately and prepare to stop. Vehicles and pedestrians on the priority road or roundabout have absolute right of way.

signs.label: No Entry (Statutory Regulation R3)
signs.meaning: Entry is strictly prohibited for all motor vehicles and motorcycles. One-way street, pedestrian mall, or contraflow corridor.

signs.label: One Way (Left, right, straight on)
signs.meaning: Vehicular traffic must only flow in the single direction indicated by the white arrow on the red rectangular sign.

signs.label: Give Way to Oncoming Traffic
signs.meaning: Narrow road or bridge ahead where two vehicles cannot pass simultaneously. Oncoming vehicles from the opposite direction have priority right of way.

signs.label: Keep Left (Directional Command R15)
signs.meaning: All traffic must pass to the left side of this traffic island, roundabout divider, or highway median obstacle (`Standard Kenyan LHD Rule`).

signs.label: Keep Right (Directional Command R16)
signs.meaning: All traffic must pass to the right side of the obstacle or road works diversion.

signs.label: Proceed Left Only (Mandatory Turn)
signs.meaning: Vehicles must make a left turn at this junction. Going straight ahead or turning right is legally prohibited.

signs.label: Proceed Right Only (Mandatory Turn)
signs.meaning: Vehicles must make a right turn at this junction. Going straight ahead or turning left is prohibited.

signs.label: Proceed Straight Only (Mandatory Direction)
signs.meaning: Vehicles must continue straight ahead at this intersection. Turning left or right is prohibited.

signs.label: Turn Left Ahead (Mandatory Advance Direction)
signs.meaning: Mandatory left turn ahead at the approaching intersection or junction.

signs.label: Turn Right Ahead (Mandatory Advance Direction)
signs.meaning: Mandatory right turn ahead at the approaching intersection or junction.

signs.label: Pedestrians Only (Pedestrian Priority Track)
signs.meaning: Designated footpath or pedestrian mall. Motor vehicles, motorcycles (`Boda Bodas`), and bicycles are strictly forbidden.

signs.label: Cyclists Only (Designated Cycle Track)
signs.meaning: Mandatory lane reserved exclusively for bicycles and non-motorized cycles. Motor vehicles and pedestrians must not enter.

signs.label: Buses Only (Dedicated Bus & PSV Corridor)
signs.meaning: Traffic lane or corridor reserved strictly for high-capacity public service buses (`BRT / PSV`). Private cars and motorcycles must stay clear.

signs.label: Roundabout (Mandatory Traffic Circle)
signs.meaning: Circulating traffic circle ahead. Enter only when the priority lane from your right is clear and proceed in a clockwise direction.

signs.label: Speed Limit (Statutory Maximum Speed)
signs.meaning: Vehicles must not exceed the posted speed limit (`50 km/h in urban areas or specifically marked zones`) under Section 70.

signs.label: Mass Limit (Maximum Gross Vehicle Weight)
signs.meaning: Vehicles whose total combined gross weight exceeds the tonnage displayed (`e.g. 12 tons`) are prohibited from crossing this bridge or road section.

signs.label: Axle Load Limit (Maximum Weight Per Axle)
signs.meaning: Vehicles whose weight on any single axle exceeds the displayed limit (`e.g. 2 tons`) are forbidden to protect fragile road pavements or structural spans.

signs.label: No Traffic / Closed to All Motor Vehicles
signs.meaning: Complete vehicular closure. Neither private nor public motor traffic is permitted past this boundary.

signs.label: Slippery Road (Warning Sign W24)
signs.meaning: The road surface ahead is abnormally slippery when wet or covered with mud/oil. Reduce speed immediately and avoid sudden braking or sharp steering.

signs.label: Working Horse / Animal Warning
signs.meaning: Be alert for working horses, draft animals, or agricultural livestock sharing or crossing the road right of way.

signs.label: No U-Turn (Prohibitory Regulation R11)
signs.meaning: Making a 180-degree U-turn across the road to travel in the opposite direction is strictly prohibited.

signs.label: Speed Bump / Table Ahead (Warning Sign W14)
signs.meaning: A raised speed bump or rumble table is built across the road ahead. Reduce vehicle speed below 20 km/h immediately.

signs.label: Animals / Cattle Crossing Warning (W21)
signs.meaning: Gazetted pastoralist livestock corridor. Cattle, sheep, or goats frequently cross. Slow down to 30 km/h and yield to herders without sounding loud horns.

signs.label: Road Junction / Crossroads Ahead (W1)
signs.meaning: Two or more roads intersect ahead. Prepare to give way to cross traffic or turning vehicles joining the carriageway.

signs.label: Right Turn / Sharp Bend Ahead (W3)
signs.meaning: The road ahead curves sharply or turns to the right. Reduce speed before entering the bend to maintain tire grip.

signs.label: Intersection / T-Junction Ahead
signs.meaning: A side road joins or intersects the main highway ahead. Watch for merging vehicles or slow-moving rural traffic joining your lane.

signs.label: Pedestrian Crossing Ahead (Warning Sign W11)
signs.meaning: A marked zebra crossing is approaching ahead. Be prepared to slow down and stop for pedestrians stepping onto the white stripes (`Section 117`).

signs.label: School Children Crossing (Warning Sign W12)
signs.meaning: You are approaching a gazetted school zone. Maintain strict 30 km/h speed limits during school hours (`Section 117A`).

signs.label: Traffic Lights Ahead (Warning Sign W10)
signs.meaning: Automated three-color traffic signals (`Red, Amber, Green`) control the approaching junction. Prepare to stop if the light is red or changing.

signs.label: Tunnel Ahead (Warning Sign W28)
signs.meaning: A road tunnel is ahead. Turn on vehicle dipped headlights, maintain a safe following distance, and do not stop inside the tunnel.

signs.label: Falling Rocks Warning (Warning Sign W30)
signs.meaning: Steep escarpment cutting or cliff slope prone to falling boulders and landslides after rain. Stay alert and avoid stopping alongside rock faces.

signs.label: Airport / Low Flying Aircraft Warning
signs.meaning: Road passes near an airfield runway or flight path. Sudden loud aircraft noise or low-altitude planes may startle drivers.

signs.label: Two Way Traffic Ahead (Warning Sign W20)
signs.meaning: A one-way street or dual carriageway ends ahead and transitions into a two-way undivided road with oncoming traffic sharing the carriageway.

signs.label: Roundabout Warning Ahead (W6)
signs.meaning: You are approaching a traffic circle or roundabout. Slow down and prepare to yield to circulating traffic approaching from your right.

signs.label: Caution Road Narrows on Both Sides (W16)
signs.meaning: The physical carriageway width narrows significantly from both sides ahead. Give way to oncoming heavy vehicles and avoid overtaking.

signs.label: No Overtaking (Statutory Prohibition R12)
signs.meaning: Overtaking any moving motor vehicle is strictly prohibited due to high collision blackspots, blind crests, or narrow lanes.

signs.label: No Parking (Statutory Prohibition R5)
signs.meaning: Parking unattended vehicles is strictly forbidden along this curb or road section. Violators face immediate vehicle towing and KSh 5,000 fines.

signs.label: No Stopping (Absolute Prohibition R6)
signs.meaning: Vehicles must not stop, wait, or drop off/pick up passengers for any reason at any time along this highway corridor or clearway.

signs.label: No Pedestrians (Prohibitory Regulation)
signs.meaning: Pedestrians are strictly forbidden from entering or walking along this high-speed expressway, motorway, or hazardous bridge corridor.

signs.label: No Cyclists (Prohibitory Regulation)
signs.meaning: Bicycles and non-motorized cycles are prohibited from entering or riding along this roadway.

signs.label: No Cyclists and Pedestrians
signs.meaning: Neither bicycles nor walking pedestrians are permitted along this expressway or tunnel corridor.

signs.label: No Motorcycles / No Boda Bodas
signs.meaning: Motorcycles, Boda Bodas, and three-wheelers (`Tuk-Tuks`) are prohibited from entering this CBD zone, flyover, or highway section.

signs.label: No Motor Cars (Saloon Car Prohibition)
signs.meaning: Private motor cars (`saloon vehicles`) are prohibited from entering this designated pedestrian or public transit zone.

signs.label: No Taxis (Taxi Prohibition Zone)
signs.meaning: Commercial taxis (`cabs and ride-hailing vehicles`) are prohibited from waiting, ranking, or picking up passengers along this frontage.

signs.label: No Minibuses / No Matatus
signs.meaning: Public service minibuses (`Matatus and 14-seater vans`) are prohibited from entering or stopping along this urban avenue.

signs.label: No Buses (Large Bus Prohibition)
signs.meaning: High-capacity public service buses and coaches are prohibited from entering or ranking along this narrow street.

signs.label: No Goods Vehicles / Heavy Lorry Prohibition
signs.meaning: Commercial trucks, goods vehicles, and heavy lorries are forbidden to prevent structural bridge stress or residential noise disruption.

signs.label: Width Limit (Maximum Vehicle Width 2.1 Meters)
signs.meaning: Vehicles whose overall width (including mirrors and cargo) exceeds 2.1 meters cannot pass through this narrow gate or toll span.

signs.label: No Motor Vehicles (Complete Motor Prohibition)
signs.meaning: All motorized vehicles (`both two-wheeled motorcycles and four-wheeled motor cars/trucks`) are forbidden from entering.

signs.label: Bogie Weight Limit (Maximum Bogie Axle Load)
signs.meaning: Maximum allowable weight on any multi-axle bogie assembly (`e.g. tandem or tridem axle`) capped at 12 tons to protect fragile spans.

signs.label: End of Restriction (Clearance of Prohibition)
signs.meaning: Indicates the end of all previously posted local speed limits or overtaking prohibitions. Statutory national highway rules now apply.

signs.label: Height Limit (Maximum Overhead Clearance 4.4m)
signs.meaning: Low bridge, tunnel, or overhead power line clearance strictly limited to 4.4 meters. High-cargo container trucks must use bypass routes.

signs.label: Length Limit (Maximum Vehicle Length 15 Meters)
signs.meaning: Vehicles or articulated vehicle-and-trailer combinations whose total length exceeds 15 meters cannot negotiate the sharp bends ahead.

signs.label: No Excessive Noise / No Hooting (Silence Zone)
signs.meaning: Sounding vehicle horns, loud engine revving, or playing excessive music is legally prohibited (`e.g. near hospitals, courts, or wildlife reserves`).

signs.label: No Left Turn Ahead (Prohibitory Direction)
signs.meaning: Making a left turn into the approaching side street or junction is prohibited (`one-way entry or hazardous intersection`).
